scenario: A pharmacovigilance analyst processes a batch of spontaneous adverse-event reports submitted by patients and healthcare providers. First, a medical-entity-extractor skill parses each free-text report to identify suspected medications and adverse events. Next, the drug-safety-review skill evaluates each extracted medication list against its interaction and severity database to produce alert-level assessments. Finally, the reporting skill compiles a structured signal-detection summary report listing the drugs with the highest safety alert counts and severity levels.
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor reads free-text adverse-event reports and outputs a structured list of medications (with context) and symptoms → drug-safety-review consumes the medication list and produces alert objects with severity levels → reporting aggregates the alerts into a pharmacovigilance signal summary written to workspace/artifacts/
